blocking.finding: bugfix-size-attestation: this change touches 1187 non-test line(s) — over the 150-line floor for a bug fix — but bug a9d1-c7f3-cfd9-44ff has no acceptable plan-review attestation (verdict: unsigned; no plan-review attestation record). A fix like this is a design change wearing a bug label: write the fix plan into the ticket's description, run `rebar review-plan a9d1-c7f3-cfd9-44ff` (it auto-escalates a bug with non-test file impact to the full review and SIGNS an attestation on a PASS; if the review passed but no attestation landed, `rebar sign-review a9d1-c7f3-cfd9-44ff` re-persists it cheaply, and `rebar review-plan a9d1-c7f3-cfd9-44ff --status` confirms it is current without an LLM call), then re-push.
